prompt: Not until the satellite ______ the outer rim of the solar system ______ it begin to transmit the high-resolution images we see today.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' yapısı cümle başında kullanıldığında ana cümleyi devrik (Inversion) yapar. Geçmişte tamamlanmış bir süreci nitelediği için 'reached / did' dizilimi doğrudur.

prompt: It is of paramount importance that the committee ______ the proposal thoroughly before any funds ______ to the project.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'It is important/essential that' yapısı Subjunctive gerektirir (scrutinize - yalın). İkinci kısımda ise fonların projeye 'tahsis edilmesi' (edilgen) Subjunctive devamı veya Present Simple Passive (be allocated) olarak tercih edilir.

prompt: The suspect is alleged ______ the secure database multiple times, though no physical evidence ______ so far.
A: to have accessed / has been found
E: to be accessed / will be found
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Is alleged to have V3' (geçmişte yapmış olduğu iddia ediliyor). İkinci kısımda 'so far' (şu ana kadar) ipucu olduğu için Present Perfect Passive (has been found) kullanılır.

prompt: Had the warnings ______ more seriously by the local residents, the casualties ______ much lower during the flood.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional devrik ve pasif yapısı (Had + S + been V3). Sonuç kısmı da geçmişteki hayali durumu nitelediği için 'would have been V3' olur.

prompt: Rarely ______ such a complex problem ______ with such simple and elegant solutions as in this case study.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely' (Inversion). Problem 'çözüldüğü' (edilgen) ve genel/yakın bir tespiti ifade ettiği için Present Perfect Passive (has ... been resolved) doğrudur.

prompt: The manager, ______ leadership style is often described as autocratic, insisted that the staff ______ on weekends.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: İyelik bildiren Relative Clause (whose style). 'Insisted that' (Subjunctive) gereği fiil özneye bakılmaksızın yalın (work) kalır.

prompt: So intense ______ the heat from the forest fire that the rescue teams ______ to retreat to a safer distance.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'So + Sıfat + be + S + that' devrik yapısı. Isı o kadar yoğundu ki ekipler geri çekilmeye 'zorlandı' (were forced - pasif).

prompt: By the time the new tax laws ______ next month, many small business owners ______ their accounting procedures.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'By the time + Present Simple, Future Perfect (will have V3)' kuralı. Gelecekte bir ana kadar tamamlanmış olacak eylemleri anlatır.

prompt: Were the board ______ swifter action when the scandal broke, the company's reputation ______ today.
A: to have taken / wouldn't be so damaged
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Were + S + to have V3' (Geçmişteki hayali durum) ve 'today' (şimdiki sonuç) birleşimiyle Mixed Conditional devriği.

prompt: No sooner ______ the diplomat arrived at the summit ______ he was confronted by a group of angry protesters.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No sooner ... than' kalıbı (Inversion: had + S + V3) YDS'nin en sevdiği gramer yapılarından biridir.

prompt: The archaeologist, ______ groundbreaking research was published last week, is thought ______ a significant discovery.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Whose research' (araştırması). 'Is thought' pasif inanışından sonra 'yapmış olduğu' (geçmiş) anlamı için 'to have made' kullanılır.

prompt: Little ______ the researchers expect that their findings ______ the entire field of molecular biology.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Little' (Inversion: did + S + V1). 'Would' ise geçmişten bakılan gelecek (gelecekte devrim yaratacağını az biliyorlardı) anlamı katar.

prompt: It is vital that the witness ______ the truth, lest an innocent man ______ for a crime he did not commit.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Hem 'Vital that' hem de 'Lest' (olmasın diye) yapıları Subjunctive gerektirir (yalın fiil: tell / be punished).

prompt: Under no circumstances ______ students be allowed to use mobile phones during the ______ examination.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Under no circumstances' (Inversion). Bir kural/yasak bildirdiği için 'should' ve 'upcoming' (yaklaşan) kelimeleri uyumludur.

prompt: Only by ______ the most advanced technology ______ scientists able to track the migration patterns of whales.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only by + V-ing' yapısı cümle başında devrik yapı gerektirir (were scientists able).

prompt: Scarcely ______ the engine started ______ a strange noise began to emanate from under the hood.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Scarcely ... when' (Inversion: had + S + V3) kuralıdır.

prompt: The professor suggested that the research ______ for another year due to the ______ of data.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Suggest that' (Subjunctive: be continued). 'the ... of' arası isim (scarcity - kıtlık) gelmelidir.

prompt: Not for a single moment ______ the doctor doubt that the patient ______ fully from the surgery.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not for a single moment' (Inversion: did ... doubt). 'Would' ise geçmişte yapılan bir tahmindir.

prompt: Should there ______ any further complications, the surgery ______ to be postponed indefinitely.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Should there be' (olursa). 'Will have to be' (olmak zorunda kalacak) - gelecek zorunluluk.

prompt: The findings ______ in the journal indicate that the sea levels ______ more rapidly than previously thought.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Findings (which were) published' (yayınlanan bulgular - kısaltma). İkinci kısım ise süregelen bir durumu (are rising) anlatır.

prompt: Neither the manager ______ the employees ______ aware of the budget cuts until the official announcement.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Neither ... nor' yapısında fiil en yakın özneye (employees - çoğul) göre çekimlenir.

prompt: It is high time the city council ______ the issue of traffic congestion, which ______ to worsen every year.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'It is high time + Past Simple (addressed)'. İkinci kısım ise genel bir tespittir (seems).

prompt: The more ______ the economic situation becomes, the more ______ the government is to intervene in the market.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'The more ... the more' yapısında sıfat (adjective) kullanılır (volatile / likely).

prompt: Such ______ the force of the wind during the hurricane ______ entire roofs were ripped off buildings.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Such + be + S + that' (Öyle ... idi ki) devrik kalıbıdır.

prompt: Had the engineers ______ the bridge's structural integrity earlier, the collapse ______ successfully.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional (geçmiş devrik) ve pasif sonuç (could have been prevented).

prompt: The suspect is believed ______ the country using a forged passport shortly after the robbery ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Believed to have V3' (fled - kaçmış olduğu). Olay (robbery) geçmişte bittiği için V2 (occurred) kullanılır.

prompt: Rarely ______ such a talented young artist managed to captivate the ______ of the entire world.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely has ... managed' (Inversion). 'the'dan sonra isim (attention) gelir.

prompt: It is essential that every applicant ______ their credentials ______ to ensure accuracy.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Essential that' (Subjunctive: verify). Eylemi niteleyen zarf (carefully) doğrudur.

prompt: ______ for the quick response of the emergency services, many more people ______ in the apartment fire.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'But for' (olmasaydı - Type 3). Hızlı müdahale olmasaydı insanlar ölecekti (would have perished).

prompt: The discovery, ______ details were leaked to the press yesterday, is expected ______ the energy industry.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Discovery whose details' (detayları sızdırılan keşif). 'Expected to V1' (to transform).

prompt: No matter how hard they ______, the scientists ______ to replicate the experimental results.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No matter how' (zıtlık). 'Tried / were unable' geçmiş zaman uyumu sağlar.

prompt: It is recommended that the patient ______ the new medication ______ any side effects occur.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Recommended that' (Subjunctive: take). 'In case' (durumunda/olur diye).

prompt: Only after having ______ the entire report ______ the manager feel ready to present the findings.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only after having V3' (ana cümlede Inversion: did ... feel).

prompt: The novel, ______ plot is quite predictable, is nevertheless ______ reading for its beautiful prose.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'whose plot' (kurgusu). 'Be worth V-ing' kalıbı (worth reading).

prompt: Rarely ______ such a violent storm ______ this region of the country in recorded history.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely has ... struck' (Inversion). Present Perfect devriği.

prompt: It is mandatory that all files ______ to the main server before the ______ of the business day.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Mandatory that' (Subjunctive Passive: be uploaded). 'the close of' (gün sonu) isim tamlaması.

prompt: Not until the implementation of the new law ______ the crime rate begin to ______ significantly.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' (Inversion: did ... begin).

prompt: The witness ______ to have seen the suspect ______ the bank shortly before the alarm went off.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Claims to have V3' (iddia ediyor). Birini bir şeyi yaparken görmek (see someone V-ing).

prompt: Should there ______ any further delays, the project ______ to be completed by the end of the year.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Should there be' (olursa). 'Is unlikely' (beklenmiyor/olası değil).

prompt: Such ______ the complexity of the task that it took the team ______ three years to complete it.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Such was the complexity' (Karmaşıklık o kadardı ki). 'Nearly' (neredeyse) zarfı süreyi niteler.

prompt: Little ______ the inventors know that their device ______ eventually become a household name.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Little did they know' (Bilmiyorlardı). 'Would' geçmişteki gelecek tahmini.

prompt: Were the vaccine ______ safer, the public ______ much more willing to participate in the trials.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Were + S + to V1' (Type 2 devrik). Güncel hayali durum.

prompt: By the time the search mission ______, the survivors ______ for over forty-eight hours.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'By the time + Past, Past Perfect' zaman uyumu kuralı.

prompt: It is essential that the researcher ______ the data meticulously ______ skewing the final results.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Essential that' (Subjunctive: analyze). 'To avoid' (sakınmak için - amaç bildirir).

prompt: Rarely ______ such an intricate mechanism ______ by ancient civilizations in this part of the world.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely' (Inversion). Mekanizma 'keşfedildiği' için pasif Present Perfect (has ... been discovered).

prompt: The more ______ the training program, the more ______ the employees will be to new challenges.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'The more ... the more' + Sıfat + Sıfat yapısı.

prompt: Not until the sun ______ ______ the temperature began to rise above freezing point.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' (Zaman bağlacı kısmı düz, ana cümle devrik: did ... begin).

prompt: The CEO insisted that the audit ______ by an external firm to ensure total ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Insist that' (Subjunctive Passive: be conducted). 'Transparency' (şeffaflık - isim).

prompt: Had the engineers ______ the structural defect earlier, the bridge ______ collapse during the storm.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional devriği (Had ... identified / wouldn't have V3).

prompt: No sooner ______ the satellite reached orbit ______ it began transmitting high-resolution data.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No sooner ... than' standart kalıp kullanımı.

prompt: It is imperative that the witness ______ the truth, lest an innocent man ______ convicted.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Imperative that' ve 'Lest' yapıları Subjunctive (yalın fiil: tell / be) gerektirir.

prompt: Under no circumstances ______ the project manager ______ to share confidential data with third parties.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Under no circumstances' (Inversion). 'Should agree' (yasak/tavsiye bildirimi).

prompt: The building, ______ construction was delayed by the strike, ______ finally be completed next month.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'whose construction' (inşaatı geciken). 'will be' (gelecek zaman).

prompt: Only after having ______ the data multiple times ______ the researchers feel confident.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only after having V3' (Inversion: did ... feel).

prompt: Not until the ship ______ the harbor ______ the passengers begin to disembark.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' (Past, did + S + V1) kuralı.

prompt: It is mandatory that every employee ______ the safety drill, ______ of their rank or department.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Mandatory that' (Subjunctive: attend). 'Regardless of' (bakılmaksızın).

prompt: Scarcely ______ the conductor raised his baton ______ the orchestra began to play.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Scarcely ... when' kalıbı.

prompt: The evidence ______ by the forensic team indicates that the fire ______ deliberately.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Evidence (which was) gathered' (kısaltma). Yangın yakıldığı için pasif (was set).

prompt: Had the warnings ______ seriously by the local residents, the casualties ______ much lower.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional devrik ve pasif yapısı.

prompt: The discovery was considered ______; it not only solved a mystery but also provided a map.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Pivotal' (hayati/kilit) kelimesi anlamı ve gramer vurgusunu tamamlar.

prompt: Rarely ______ we encounter a situation ______ both sides are so willing to compromise.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely do we encounter' (Inversion). 'Situation where' (Relative Clause).

prompt: The more ______ the economic data is, the more ______ the market reacts to small changes.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'The more ... the more' + Sıfat + Sıfat.

prompt: Only by ______ the most recent figures ______ the committee make an informed decision.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only by' (Inversion: could ... make).

prompt: No sooner ______ the whistle blown ______ the players began to argue with the referee.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No sooner ... than' kalıbı.

prompt: The witness, ______ motives are questionable, claims ______ the crime happen.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'whose motives' (motifleri). 'Claims to have seen' (gördüğünü iddia ediyor).

prompt: It is essential that the scientist ______ the variables meticulously ______ the results.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Essential that' (Subjunctive: verify). 'To confirm' (doğrulamak için).

prompt: Rarely ______ such a complex issue ______ with so much clarity as in this report.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely has ... been addressed' (Inversion + Passive).

prompt: Should you ______ any further assistance, please do not ______ to contact us.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Should' devrik Type 1. 'Do not hesitate' (duraksamayın).

prompt: The suspect is believed ______ the bank ______ last year's holiday season.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Believed to have robbed' (soymuş olduğu). 'During' (boyunca/sırasında).

prompt: Had the warnings ______ seriously by the local authorities, the casualties ______ lower.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional devrik ve pasif yapısı.

prompt: Not until the implementation of the new law ______ the crime rate ______ to decline.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' (Past: did ... begin).

prompt: The witness ______ to have seen the perpetrator ______ the bank shortly before the alarm.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Claims to have V3' + 'leaving' (yaparken görmek).

prompt: It is imperative that the team ______ the deadline, lest the project ______ cancelled.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Çift Subjunctive yapısı.

prompt: Scarcely ______ the conductor raised his baton ______ the orchestra began to play.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Scarcely ... when' kalıbı.

prompt: Such ______ the force of the blast that the entire building ______ compromised.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Such was ... that ... was' (Geçmiş durum uyumu).

prompt: Only after ______ the data ______ the researchers feel confident.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only after' (Inversion: did ... feel).

prompt: Little ______ the explorers know that the cave ______ for thousands of years.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Little did they know' + 'had been inhabited'.

prompt: The athlete is thought ______ the record during the ______ competition.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'thought to break' (kırması bekleniyor). 'upcoming' (gelecek/yaklaşan).

prompt: Were the government ______ swifter action, the crisis ______ avoided.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 2 devrik (Were ... to take). Sonuç (could be).

prompt: The discovery was ______; it opened up new avenues for research.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Pivotal' (kilit noktada/hayati).
